proposal.reason: Main change is in logical channel/ring graph construction and mapping, so graph-search is primary: src/graph/connect.cc adds per-graph channelMap propagation across copy/shuffle, fixes SM80/SM89 channel remap behavior, and moves reverse-ring application to Postset with rank-neighbor swaps after node assignment; src/graph/search.cc switches net-device lookup to channelMap and validates cached proxy endpoints (send rank + NIC) before reuse. src/include/graph.h adds channelMap/ringReverse state used by this flow, and src/init.cc only wires shuffle inputs/guard rails for the same graph behavior rather than introducing an independent communicator/network policy change.
